description: Two/three-round conditional semi-adaptive parallel amplitude estimation using a top-down r=1.50 geometric ladder with lean Round-1 shot ramp (slope=0.85), Round-2 complementary opposite-slope phase steering (+-phi_0) with Bhattacharyya rival-aware depth selection and conditional rival-killer shots, and a conditional Round-3 tie-breaker (triggered on ~4% of trials when Delta_ell_2 < 4.5).
